records.jp: 原種……？
records.en_original: The Sephira...?
records.en_auxiliary: The Sephira...?
records.en: The Sephira...?

records.jp: うん。私は何体もの原種と戦った。<CR>思い出せたのは、それくらいかな……
records.en_original: Yeah. I fought plenty of Sephira, but that's all I remember.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. I fought plenty of Sephira, but that's all I remember.
records.en: Yeah. I fought plenty of Sephira, but that's all I remember.

records.jp: 原種って、そもそも何なの？
records.en_original: What exactly are these Sephira?
records.en_auxiliary: What exactly are these Sephira?
records.en: What exactly are these Sephira?

records.jp: 世界の管理者候補……みたいなものだと思う。<CR>一番強い原種が世界の管理者になれるんだって
records.en_original: As far as I know, they're contending to become the overseer of the world. The strongest Sephira wins.
records.en_auxiliary: As far as I know, they're contending to become the overseer of the world. The strongest Sephira wins.
records.en: As far as I know, they're contending to become the overseer of the world. The strongest Sephira wins.

records.jp: 当時管理者だった原種は人間を一つに融合しようと<CR>してて……最後はそれを止めるために戦ったんだ
records.en_original: The overseer at the time wanted to merge all humans into one being... I fought it to stop that from happening.
records.en_auxiliary: The overseer at the time wanted to merge all humans into one being... I fought it to stop that from happening.
records.en: The overseer at the time wanted to merge all humans into one being... I fought it to stop that from happening.

records.jp: 何それ。やっぱ神様の考えることは分かんないなー
records.en_original: The heck? Gods sure do come up with some crazy ideas.
records.en_auxiliary: The heck? Gods sure do come up with some crazy ideas.
records.en: The heck? Gods sure do come up with some crazy ideas.

records.jp: 私が原種と戦ったことって、<CR>灰が降ったことと関係あるのかな……？
records.en_original: Could my battle with the Sephira have something to do with the Ash?
records.en_auxiliary: Could my battle with the Sephira have something to do with the Ash?
records.en: Could my battle with the Sephira have something to do with the Ash?

records.jp: どう、ユズさん？
records.en_original: What do you think, Yuzu?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you think, Yuzu?
records.en: What do you think, Yuzu-san?

records.jp: ある、と理屈づけることはできる
records.en_original: If it does, I think I may have a theory.
records.en_auxiliary: If it does, I think I may have a theory.
records.en: If it does, I think I may have a theory.

records.jp: 例えば――日菜子が言うように、<CR>原種がこの世界の管理者だったとするならば……
records.en_original: Let's say that Hinako is right, that the Sephira was the overseer. That means...
records.en_auxiliary: Let's say that Hinako is right, that the Sephira was the overseer. That means...
records.en: Let's say that Hinako is right, that the Sephira was the overseer. That means...

records.jp: 管理者を倒してしまって、<CR>世界が管理されなくなったからおかしくなった、とか
records.en_original: If the overseer was to be defeated, there would be no one to oversee the world, leaving it out of balance.
records.en_auxiliary: If the overseer was to be defeated, there would be no one to oversee the world, leaving it out of balance.
records.en: If the overseer was to be defeated, there would be no one to oversee the world, leaving it out of balance.

records.jp: なるほどね～
records.en_original: Ohhh, that makes sense...
records.en_auxiliary: Ohhh, that makes sense...
records.en: Ohhh, that makes sense...

records.jp: どうしたの、愛央ちゃん？
records.en_original: What are you thinking, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: What are you thinking, Ao?
records.en: What are you thinking, Ao-chan?

records.jp: いやぁ、コールドスリープ説は違ったかー！<CR>って思ってさー
records.en_original: That my cryostasis theory was totally wrong!
records.en_auxiliary: That my cryostasis theory was totally wrong!
records.en: That my cryostasis theory was totally wrong!

records.jp: 私みたいな凡人の想像力じゃ及びもつかない<CR>領域の話になってきちゃったよ
records.en_original: No way a regular person like me could come up with something like this...
records.en_auxiliary: No way a regular person like me could come up with something like this...
records.en: No way a regular person like me could come up with something like this...

records.jp: でも、結構いい線行ってたんじゃない？
records.en_original: You were surprisingly close, however.
records.en_auxiliary: You were surprisingly close, however.
records.en: You were surprisingly close, however.

records.jp: 実際はコールドスリープじゃなくて、<CR>灰からの隔離？　だったわけだけど……
records.en_original: We may not be in cryostasis, but you were correct about us being protected from the Ash.
records.en_auxiliary: We may not be in cryostasis, but you were correct about us being protected from the Ash.
records.en: We may not be in cryostasis, but you were correct about us being protected from the Ash.

records.jp: でも、どうして私たちなんだろうね？
records.en_original: But why us?
records.en_auxiliary: But why us?
records.en: But why us?

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 自分で言うのもなんだけど、世界のピンチを<CR>私たちみたいな学生がどうにかできるとは思えないよ
records.en_original: I don't want to be the one to say it, but what can a group of college students do to save the world?
records.en_auxiliary: I don't want to be the one to say it, but what can a group of college students do to save the world?
records.en: I don't want to be the one to say it, but what can a group of college students do to save the world?

records.jp: 雫世界に入るなら、もっとふさわしい人がいるはず。<CR>灰の専門家とか……
records.en_original: There has to be someone in Oasis better prepared for this. An expert on the Ash or something...
records.en_auxiliary: There has to be someone in Oasis better prepared for this. An expert on the Ash or something...
records.en: There has to be someone in Oasis better prepared for this. An expert on the Ash or something...

records.jp: ……何か理由があると思うのです。<CR>わたしたちじゃないといけない理由が
records.en_original: I believe there is a reason for it. A reason that it has to be us.
records.en_auxiliary: I believe there is a reason for it. A reason that it has to be us.
records.en: I believe there is a reason for it. A reason that it has to be us.

records.jp: 単純に、こういう場所は他にいくつもあって、<CR>たまたまここには私たちしかいないのかも？
records.en_original: Maybe there are other places like this and we just happen to be the only ones here.
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe there are other places like this and we just happen to be the only ones here.
records.en: Maybe there are other places like this and we just happen to be the only ones here.

records.jp: 記憶を取り戻していけば、いつか答えに<CR>たどり着くんじゃないかな
records.en_original: If we keep going and get everyone's memories back, I'm sure we'll find some answers.
records.en_auxiliary: If we keep going and get everyone's memories back, I'm sure we'll find some answers.
records.en: If we keep going and get everyone's memories back, I'm sure we'll find some answers.

records.jp: ……そうだね
records.en_original: ...I hope so.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I hope so.
records.en: ...I hope so.

records.jp: とはいえ、どうしましょう？　記憶を取り戻すと<CR>言っても、ヒントがない状態ですが……
records.en_original: So, what do we do now? Even if we want to get our memories back, we have no idea how to go about it.
records.en_auxiliary: So, what do we do now? Even if we want to get our memories back, we have no idea how to go about it.
records.en: So, what do we do now? Even if we want to get our memories back, we have no idea how to go about it.

records.jp: 記憶を刺激するものがないか、<CR>地道に探していくしかない
records.en_original: If we don't have anything to stimulate our memories here, then we have no choice but to keep looking.
records.en_auxiliary: If we don't have anything to stimulate our memories here, then we have no choice but to keep looking.
records.en: If we don't have anything to stimulate our memories here, then we have no choice but to keep looking.

records.jp: まだココロトープが出てない人もいるよね？<CR>それを出す方法を探すっていうのもありかも
records.en_original: Some of our Heartscapes still haven't shown up. We could look for a way to make them appear.
records.en_auxiliary: Some of our Heartscapes still haven't shown up. We could look for a way to make them appear.
records.en: Some of our Heartscapes still haven't shown up. We could look for a way to make them appear.

records.jp: うーん、何か方法はあるかな……
records.en_original: Hmm, I wonder how we could do that...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm, I wonder how we could do that...
records.en: Hmm, I wonder how we could do that...

records.jp: だめだー！　思い浮かばない！
records.en_original: Ugh! I'm coming up totally blank!
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh! I'm coming up totally blank!
records.en: Ugh! I'm coming up totally blank!

records.jp: 勇希は何か浮かんだ？
records.en_original: Got any ideas, Yuki?
records.en_auxiliary: Got any ideas, Yuki?
records.en: Got any ideas, Yuki?

records.jp: ふっふっふ。<CR>もちろんだよ！
records.en_original: Heheh... You know I do!
records.en_auxiliary: Heheh... You know I do!
records.en: Heheh... You know I do!

records.jp: 記憶を刺激するなら……。<CR>今こそ学校魔改造計画、再・再始動の時……！
records.en_original: If we're trying to jog our memory... It'd be a great time for the extreme school makeover planning committee to come out of retirement!
records.en_auxiliary: If we're trying to jog our memory... It'd be a great time for the extreme school makeover planning committee to come out of retirement!
records.en: If we're trying to jog our memory... It'd be a great time for the extreme school makeover planning committee to come out of retirement!

records.jp: それ、金城さんが楽しみたいだけでしょ
records.en_original: You're just trying to make this into a game, aren't you, Kinjou?
records.en_auxiliary: You're just trying to make this into a game, aren't you, Kinjou?
records.en: You're just trying to make this into a game, aren't you, Kinjou-san?

records.jp: え～？　そんなことないよ～？
records.en_original: Whaaat? That's not true!
records.en_auxiliary: Whaaat? That's not true!
records.en: Whaaat? That's not true!

records.jp: でも、何が記憶を刺激するかわからないですし、<CR>もしかしたら……
records.en_original: We have no other ideas anyways. It may be worth trying.
records.en_auxiliary: We have no other ideas anyways. It may be worth trying.
records.en: We have no other ideas anyways. It may be worth trying.

records.jp: それで何か思い出せるかも？
records.en_original: It might help us remember something.
records.en_auxiliary: It might help us remember something.
records.en: It might help us remember something.

records.jp: さあほら、みんなアイデア出して！<CR>伶那も、欲しいものない？
records.en_original: All right, everybody! Let's get some ideas! Do you have anything you want, Rena?
records.en_auxiliary: All right, everybody! Let's get some ideas! Do you have anything you want, Rena?
records.en: All right, everybody! Let's get some ideas! Do you have anything you want, Rena?

records.jp: ……はりきってるなぁ、勇希
records.en_original: Yuki sure is excited...
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki sure is excited...
records.en: Yuki sure is excited...
